title: Jesus... I Said Yes Again When I Wanted To Say No
topic: people-pleasing and not being able to say no

bible.text: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I said yes again. I didn't want to. I never do. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: My cousin asked me to cover for her tonight. Now I'm giving up my one free evening.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You said yes so she would keep liking you. But you're tired of being liked only for being useful.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I say no, she'll be upset. Everyone will say I've changed.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Maybe you have. Growing is allowed. The people who really love you can handle hearing no.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if they can't? What if I end up with nobody?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then you'll find out who loved you, and who only loved your yes. I'm not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't have to earn your place by disappearing.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What's one thing you said yes to this week that you wish was a no? 🙏
